name: Ask UKHSA's respiratory data
description: Ask a plain question about flu, COVID-19 and RSV in England and get a short answer with charts, built from the UKHSA data dashboard's public API, with the exact series behind every number.
headline: Ask a question.|Get the *answer* and its source.
intro: Type a question about flu, COVID-19 or RSV in England. You'll get a short answer with charts, built only from figures UKHSA publishes on its data dashboard, with the exact series and reporting date behind every number.
placeholder: e.g. Is flu rising, and are hospital admissions following?
examples: Is flu rising, and are hospital admissions following?
Which age groups are being admitted to hospital with flu this autumn?
How does flu this autumn compare with the same weeks last year?
Which regions have the highest flu admission rates right now?
Is COVID-19 rising or falling in England?
How many COVID-19 patients are in hospital?
Is RSV starting to rise yet?
Which age group is most affected by RSV admissions?
When did last winter's flu admissions peak?
How did the last four flu seasons' peaks compare?
Flu vs COVID-19 vs RSV test positivity right now?
How does COVID-19 positivity differ by region?
When did flu start rising this year?
How bad was the 2022-23 flu season compared with others?
RSV admissions among under-5s each winter?
